- When sentiment is strongly bullish (≥0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1–2% for next 5–7 days.  
- When sentiment is bearish (≤0.33) or volatile (alternating ±0.33), model often underestimates or lags; add 0.5–1.5% to forecast for next 3–5 days.  
- After a sharp price spike (≥5% from prior peak), model frequently overshoots; cap forecast at +3% above peak for 3–5 days.  
- If sentiment history shows repeated short-term reversals (e.g., 0.33→1.00→0.33), model overfits recent noise; apply mean reversion to 30-day moving average for next 7 days.  
- Model consistently underestimates true price in 30-day horizon when sentiment is neutral or mixed (0.33–0.67); add 1–2% to forecast for next 10 days.
